LOCATION: Kerrisdale / SW Marine neighbourhood just a few blocks away from Kerrisdale Village for many popular local businesses and restaurants along Boulevard and W.41st Ave for all your dining, shopping and entertainment needs. Half a block walk to Save-On-Foods at W.49th and West Boulevard. Some of the local favourites include Dollarama, Sen Pho, Oakberry Acai Bowls & Smoothies, Southern Delicacy, Michele Cake Shop, Fryday Chicken, Sandeul Korean, Sandy Farm Market, MACU Tea, Steam Teahouse, Honolulu Coffeee, Baoguette Vietnamese Bistro, Okini Restaurant & Bar, Bean Around the World and Choices Market. 5 minutes' drive to Oakridge Shopping Centre and 15 minutes to UBC. Children walk two blocks to Maple Grove Elementary and Magee Secondary and 6 of the top BC private schools within 15 minutes' drive, including Little Flower Academy, Crofton House, St. George's, York House, West Point Grey and Vancouver College. In your backyard is the popular Arbutus Greenway, which replaces the old train tracks and connects Vancouver Southlands all the way to False Creek waterfront jogging, blading or biking.

FEATURES: Bannister Mews is one of the most distinguished townhome developments in Kerrisdale in recent years. Located at Arbutus and W.49th built within a retained and restored historic stone wall, this project combines architectural cues that exemplify characters of this historic neighbourhood with modern luxurious interior design. This 1,271sf, 3 levels, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms townhouse features hardwood and engineered laminate floors throughout. Up the foyer to the main living area is the huge rectangular living room, dining area with ceiling fan and kitchen. The gourmet kitchen comes with shaker wood cabinetry, granite countertop, stainless steel Bosch and Fisher & Paykel appliances, and a serving counter. Huge breakfast nook also has ceiling fan and view of the backyard. Here you have access to a large fenced backyard. The second floor is the primary bedroom, second & third bedroom. The primary bedroom comes with a walk-in closet and a 5 pcs ensuite featuring granite countertops, two undermount lavatories, separate shower and large soaker tub. The 4 pcs main bathroom down the hall has equally high-quality fixtures. The downstairs are the laundry closet, a storage room and access to the double attached garage with tandem parking for two.
